text.name: Steadfast Shield
text.description:
{Steadfast Shield}

Gives all friendly targets +15% damage resistance. It also gives the hero +3 Defense.
text.event: You were invited to a large multi-colored tent for a celebration... but the celebration of what, it seems, the participants of the festivities themselves did not know, which was very suspicious. Wisely skipping the toast, you grabbed a large tray of fruit and pretended to be a waiter. Having chosen the right moment, you got out of this strange place. Only after shaking the food off the tray did you notice that you were holding a Steadfast Shield in your hands.
